blocking.heading: When you write a sentence
blocking.text: Only the text of these sections is the changed text.
blocking.problem: In skills/writing/agent-instructions/references/review.md line 154, "these sections" can refer to "each section of the changed part" or to "a section that you moved" in the 2 sentences before it, and with the second meaning the text of a moved section is changed text, which item 5 of the same list (line 161) and loading-rules.md do not permit.
blocking.correction: "Only the text of the sections of the changed part is the changed text."

advisory.heading: When the write job makes a SKILL.md or entry-file text
advisory.text: After the reader test: the output tests and the manual checks
advisory.problem: In /Users/alexk/Projects/agent-context/skills/writing/agent-instructions/references/review.md, lines 317-361 (this section and its subsection "When you run a manual check") have their own read condition in step 10 of SKILL.md ("after the reader test passes"), which is different from the self-check condition of step 8, but they are in the same file, so the author loads them before the self-check and each reviewer subagent, which must read review.md for its report requirements, loads 45 lines that it never uses.
advisory.correction: Move lines 317-361 without changes to `references/output-tests.md`, and change step 10 of SKILL.md to "In the other jobs, after the reader test passes, read `references/output-tests.md`. Then do the output tests and the manual checks that it gives." Also change the 2 sentences in end-of-run-report.md and SKILL.md that name "When you run a manual check" or "After the reader test: the output tests and the manual checks" in `references/review.md` to name `references/output-tests.md`.

advisory.heading: When you select the words and the tone
advisory.text: In each review round, the round list contains each file in the `Changes:` line of the reviewer prompt.
advisory.problem: In skills/writing/agent-instructions/references/review.md line 31, "the reviewer prompt" identifies no single prompt, because line 61 gives the loading reviewer a `Changes:` line without list files, so with a list file in the round, item 5 at line 42 can mark the loading reviewer as failed when it gives no report path for that list file.
advisory.correction: "In each review round, the round list of a reviewer contains each file in the `Changes:` line of the prompt of that reviewer." In line 42, write "each file in the round list of that reviewer".

advisory.heading: When you select the words and the tone
advisory.text: A reviewer also fails when its last message does not give the report path of each file in the round list.
advisory.problem: In skills/writing/agent-instructions/references/review.md line 42, a new reviewer gets the report folder of the failed reviewer, skips each file that has a report (line 124), and gives only the paths that it saved (line 125), so this criterion marks it as failed and item 6 at line 47 then sends all later rounds to "When no subagent is available".
advisory.correction: "A reviewer also fails when, after its last message, its report folder does not have the report of each file in the round list."

advisory.heading: When you put the text in sections and lists
advisory.text: The script finds 2 types of problems.
advisory.problem: In skills/writing/agent-instructions/references/review.md line 240, item 9 of the numbered reader-test list gives only information about the script output and no step of the sequence.
advisory.correction: Remove item 9 from the numbered list. Add its sentences to the end of item 8 as the result of that step: "The script finds 2 types of problems. A typical task has a problem when its report does not use a tested quote. The out-of-scope task has a problem when its report uses an added or changed line."
